column1: # OpenDubs Tab5 — OTA-capable partition table for the ESP-IDF build.
# The demo's own table is a single 10 MB `factory` app with no otadata and no second slot
# flashing it removes OTA entirely — and OTA is how the head is updated
# the robot on the e-stop-protected branch and is awkward to reach with a cable.
# nvs STAYS AT 0x9000 WITH SIZE 0x5000
column2: exactly matching the Arduino firmware's default_16MB.csv.

column1: # That is deliberate: the per-robot tilt limits and IMU offsets live in NVS
# so a region that starts at the same offset and is the same size or larger keeps its existing
# pages. Shrinking would truncate them. The demo uses 0x6000
column2: which would also have been safe

column1: # matching exactly means zero change in the one region that holds unrecoverable per-robot state.
# NO phy_init
column2: also matching the Arduino layout. The ESP32-P4 has no radio of its own — Wi-Fi is a

column1: # separate C6 reached over SDIO via esp_hosted — and the Arduino firmware has worked with Wi-Fi for
# a long time without a phy_init partition
column2: which is the evidence that the P4 does not need one.

column1: # It also cannot coexist with otadata: both want the 0x9000–0x10000 gap
column2: and otadata is the one OTA

column1: # requires.
# App slots are 5 MB each against a 2.80 MB image
column2: so there is 2.2 MB of headroom for the camera
